verdict.rationale: Retell ships its own headless control surfaces: an official CLI for managing agents, phone numbers and knowledge bases from the terminal, and official Node.js/Python SDKs with API-key auth and structured errors. Together these allow scripted, non-dashboard automation. Nothing documents CI use specifically, such as non-interactive CLI auth, pipeline examples, or CI-runnable batch tests, so the CI half of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CI/pipeline integration (e.g. GitHub Actions examples), non-interactive CLI auth and exit-code behavior, headless batch-test execution from CI, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
Typed clients with API key auth, structured errors, and full voice and chat endpoint coverage.
The Retell CLI lets you manage Retell resources from your terminal.
